description: Application-owned zero-network intake of one operator-supplied Mississippi Business Reports package into private readiness metadata.
redirect_policy: No network requests or redirects are permitted.
retry: No automatic retry; inspect the durable terminal receipt and explicitly correct or replace the local package.
checkpoint: A UUID operation owns its immutable start, manifest-last readiness report and terminal receipt. A later intake recovers interrupted work after the lock owner exits.
idempotency: Independent verification reparses the exact selected input bytes, checks the applicable independent review pin and reproduces the readiness report and manifest.
cancellation: Cooperative cancellation clears operation-owned unpublished readiness files and writes a redacted terminal receipt before releasing its lock.
retention_profile: Retain only private readiness metadata, input digests and receipts in the operation. Do not copy the operator package or persist extracted rows.
